name: godaddy
description: Connect GoDaddy to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use GoDaddy MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect GoDaddy to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with domain name search using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my GoDaddy workspace.
Find anything in GoDaddy that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review domain name search in GoDaddy.
